title: Mixture-of-Depths with Mirror block-role views
hypothesis: Under identical fixed MoD token routing, a shared MLP block with low-description role coordinates retains NLL while reducing physical block bytes and keeping active MACs within 10% of native MoD.
physical_object: three residual MLP depth-role blocks, with candidate sharing one physical block
mirror_coordinate: one scalar role coordinate for each routed block invocation
logical_multiplicity: three logical depth-role functions under identical token routing capacity
controls: native MoD with three separate blocks
tied MoD plus direct scalar gates

development.selection_metric: token NLL, per-position accuracy, actual bytes, routed MACs, capacity/overflow, latency

success_gate: Both dev seeds: Mirror NLL within 0.01 native MoD, >=10% fewer bytes than MoD, active MAC <=1.10x MoD; direct gate >=10% larger or worse quality for Mirror-specific result.
failure_gate: NLL >0.03 worse, active MAC >1.10x, or direct gate within 10%; fresh sealed.
boundaries: router is fixed identically across methods
